hero.title: Materials and cable solutions for increased fire-safety requirements
hero.text: The project focuses on developing a fire-resistant composition and applying it in cable products for critical facilities.

main.title: AVVGng(A)-LSLTx
main.text: The project targets cable products with reduced smoke and gas emissions and resistance to flame propagation. Material formulations and properties will be refined through development and testing.
main.panel: The project’s flagship direction for facilities with increased fire-safety requirements.

materials.title: Fire-resistant compositions as a standalone technology platform
materials.text: The developed technology is considered not only as part of a single cable product, but also as a basis for adapting functional compositions to different cable-material requirements.
materials.panel: Fire-resistant polymer compounds for cable insulation and sheathing.

goal.title: Production and commercial sale of cable with enhanced fire safety
goal.text: The project aims to produce AVVGng(A)-LSLTx for high-occupancy facilities and critical infrastructure.

problem.title: Increasing fire and technological safety requirements
problem.text: Standard cable solutions can create additional fire risks through flame propagation and smoke generation. Critical infrastructure especially needs local solutions aligned with modern safety requirements.

local.title: Local production

hero.title: Science, production and commercialization in one project team
hero.text: The project brings together specialists in cable production, materials, marketing and financial support.

members.name: Ruslan Kaliyev
members.short: More than 15 years of experience in electric power engineering and cable manufacturing.
members.bio: Has an experience as head of the cable production department. Since 2024, he has managed a cable manufacturing plant and is responsible for quality, production processes and commercial strategy.

members.name: Aydyn Akhmetzhanov
members.short: Specialist in marketing, sales, CRM and market-channel development.
members.bio: Has an educational background in international economics, trade and finance. Implemented and optimized CRM systems, improved sales and marketing collaboration, conducted market segmentation and optimized advertising budgets.

members.name: Indira Ilyasova
members.short: Financial support, budget control and reporting.
members.bio: Responsible for project accounting, financial-flow control, tax and HR reporting, timely fulfillment of financial obligations and financial support for the project lead.

members.name: Omirzak Kapizov
members.short: Research in functional materials and scale-up of technology solutions.
members.bio: Specializes in the development and scale-up of functional materials, including solutions for energy systems and next-generation cable products.

members.name: Dauren Mukhanov
members.short: Laboratory research, analysis and validation of results.
members.bio: Experienced in research work, development and implementation of scientific and technical solutions, laboratory and production environments, and the analysis, interpretation and validation of experimental results.
